# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the problem, affected skills, environment types, and portability limits.

## Validation

List checks run, tool versions, and sanitized lab outcomes. Label commands that
were not live-tested. Never include credentials, state, or sensitive output.

## Checklist

- [ ] Frontmatter valid; name matches leaf folder; description explains when to use.
- [ ] Safety section covers target identity, read-only/dry runs, explicit approval, and no secrets.
- [ ] Verification and realistic rollback steps included.
- [ ] Commands tested safely, or illustrative/unverified examples clearly labeled.
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive artifacts; staged diff reviewed.
- [ ] README skill table and links updated; validation passes.
- [ ] Contribution follows CONTRIBUTING.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.
